card.name: Regulatory adjectives before product or waste
card.fires_on: The adjective "medicinal" right before "product(s)", mostly after "other" or "this". Also "diagnostic" in "in vitro diagnostic" and "Hazardous" before "Waste".

card.writes: It seems to add the regulatory-style nouns that follow, such as product, use or waste, though the promoted tokens are mixed.
card.plain: It marks the EU-style wording "medicinal" in "medicinal product" and similar regulatory phrases.
